I added `clever k8s version`, with `check` and `update` subcommands. I haven't run either against a real cluster, so the API calls are untested. `npm run validate` (lint, format, types, generated docs) passed before I reverted an unrelated file, described below. I did not re-run it after that revert.

- **`check`:** `clever k8s version check <cluster>` reports whether a newer version exists. It takes `--org` and `--format human|json`. It only reads: it prints the installed and latest versions and suggests the `update` command.
- **`update`:** `clever k8s version update <cluster> [version]` upgrades the cluster. It takes `--org`. If you leave out the version, it asks you to pick from the available ones. It rejects a version that isn't available, and says so if the cluster is already on the one you asked for.

The API calls and the check/update logic (`k8sCheckVersion`, `k8sUpdateVersion` in `src/lib/k8s.js`) were already in the repo. The three new files are `k8s.version.command.js`, `k8s.version.check.command.js` and `k8s.version.update.command.js`, registered in `global.commands.js`. The k8s docs and the skill reference were regenerated.

- **Change to existing code:** the old `k8sCheckVersion` also offered to perform the update after confirming. I removed that so `check` stays read-only, and dropped the now-unused `confirm` import.
- **`since: null`:** the new commands use it, as the repo requires, so the generated docs show "Since null" until the release workflow sets the version.
- **`.claude/settings.json`:** `fix-all` reformatted it, so I reverted it to keep the change limited to this feature.
- **Dependencies:** `node_modules` was missing, so I ran `npm ci`.

I haven't committed anything.
